correctness.rationale: The finding is true, but the frozen proof's insistence on component-size weights in §2 is incorrect. In the incidence cokernel each e_ij maps to the unit generator of its connected component, so the induced augmentation sends each such generator to 1, not to the component size. The sum of original basis elements in a component would map to its size times the unit, not to a basis element. Using the correct unit-weight augmentation gives the natural quotient ker(epsilon)/im(partial_2), which surjects at every stage with free target of rank number of components minus one. For H_2 the mixed triangles are the edges of the incidence graph and each pair of deleted labels has two oriented length-two paths between diagonal vertices. A cycle has zero pendant coefficients and equal coefficients along each oriented path, and the tetrahedron relation identifies the two paths with coefficient a unit. For every pair keep the path via e_ij with i<j; these choices coincide at all stages, so the quotient is naturally the complete-graph integral cycle lattice and the star-tree circuit bases extend. The tetrahedral relations are independent, leaving no higher homology. This reconstruction proves the displayed ranks, splits and barcode despite the erroneous weight assertion. The small independent exact check at (4,5) obtained H_1 ranks (19,12,6,2,0) and H_2 ranks (0,0,0,1,3), with stabilized H_2 basis column (1,0,0).
residual_risks: Correctness is for the finding, not endorsement of the erroneous component-weight sentence or of the original proof verbatim. The frozen modular checks do not imply integral primitivity.
